newsitem.title: USA: Exar Corp sees additional Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Exar Corp sees additional Q4 charge.

text.p: Exar Corp said on Friday it will take a $9.0 million pretax reserve in the fourth quarter ended March 31 as part of a decision to end its 1995 wafer production pact with a foundry supplier.
Exar said the reserve is being taken to reflect the anticipated realizable value of equipment supplied to the foundry by Exar as part of the agreement.

The $9.0 million pretax reserve is in addition, but unrelated to, the previously announced plans for a pretax restructuring charge of $8 to $10 million for costs from the transfer of test and shipping operations to off-shore sub-contractors, together with other restructuring charges, during the fourth quarter, the company said.
